items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add the pieces you like to your cart and go to checkout. Fill in your delivery details and press “Place order on WhatsApp” — your full order opens in WhatsApp, ready to send to us. Once we receive it, we confirm availability and reply with a payment QR.

Payment is made by QR. After we confirm your order on WhatsApp, we send you a payment QR code. Pay with your banking or e-wallet app, then send us the receipt. We never ask for card details on the website.
Your order is confirmed once we have checked availability and received your payment receipt on WhatsApp. We then prepare and ship it.

items.q: Why do some items say “Price on request”?
items.a: For some ranges we confirm the price with you directly. You can still add them to your cart and check out — we’ll share the price on WhatsApp before you pay, so there are no surprises.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes, as long as it hasn’t shipped yet. Just message us on WhatsApp with your order number. Items stitched to your size can’t be cancelled once tailoring has started.

items.q: What is the difference between Unstitched and Stitched?
items.a: Our Batik Pawang range comes two ways. Unstitched is the uncut batik fabric, ready for your own tailor. Stitched is the same fabric made into a shirt in your chosen size (S, M, L or XL).
Our shirts, sets and boxers come in S, M, L and XL. Sarongs, kain and scarves are one size. If you’re between sizes, message us on WhatsApp and we’ll help you choose.

items.q: Is every design really one of a kind?
items.a: Each batik is dyed by hand, so no two pieces are ever exactly alike — the small irregularities of the wax and dye are part of the character of real batik.

items.q: Is the batik made by hand?
items.a: Yes. Batik is a wax-resist dyeing tradition: molten wax is drawn onto the cloth, then dyed in stages. Our pieces are made by artisans in Malaysia, and a single piece can take days to complete.

items.q: How do I care for my batik?
items.a: Hand-wash cold or use a gentle cycle, inside out, with mild detergent. Dry in the shade and iron on the reverse. Hand-dyed colour may soften gently over time.

We ship as soon as payment is confirmed. Unstitched fabric and ready-to-wear pieces ship fastest; stitched-to-size shirts need extra time for tailoring. We’ll give you an estimate for your address on WhatsApp.
Unworn items can be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number to start a return. See our Shipping & Returns page for full details.
